decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 2039/004, Location Plan, Proposed Floor Plan received 19/10/2011, Existing Floor Plan received 10/10/2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The hours of operation of the martial arts academy at Arch 200 shall be limited to 9am to 10pm daily, unless prior approval has been sought from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - There shall be no loading/unloading or parking within the alley way to the south of the arch (that provides pedestrian access to the Welstead Way carpark to the rear).
description: Change of use from industrial use to D2 (Sports Academy)
